name: toll_pulse_hits_all_ground
description: A pulse has no shot (contract-m6 3): every 2.4 s the Toll Tower strikes every ground creep within its 2.2 tiles at once, through the armour rule, and stuns each; a Duskmoth inside its reach and a Gourdling beyond it are untouched. Its patch branch, the Sky Toll, reaches 2.4 tiles and fliers too: a Duskmoth takes its 9 with the branch's air bonus and is slowed 50% for 2 s instead of stunned, while the ground creeps are stunned as before. Each ring is one EV_PULSE at the tower's cell centre; the creeps it struck come as EV_HIT from no shot (0).

steps.assert: p.size() == 1 and p[0]['x'] == 14500 and p[0]['z'] == 8500 and p[0]['r'] == 2200 and p[0]['form'] == 'toll_tower' and p[0]['hollow'] == 0
steps.msg: one ring, at the tower's cell centre, with its reach
every ground creep in reach is struck in the same tick, the Thornback through its armour

steps.assert: scene.creep(c[0]).stun_until > after and scene.creep(c[1]).stun_until > after and scene.creep(c[2]).stun_until > after
scene.events_where('HIT', {'creep': c[3]}).is_empty() and scene.events_where('HIT', {'creep': c[4]}).is_empty() and scene.creep(c[3]).slow_pm == 0
steps.msg: the Duskmoth in reach and the Gourdling beyond it are untouched

steps.assert: toll.branch == 1 and toll.air and toll.range_mm == 2400 and toll.air_slow_pm == 500 and toll.air_slow_t == 120 and toll.air_bonus_pm == 800
steps.msg: the Sky Toll reaches 2.4 tiles and the sky

steps.assert: p2.size() == 2 and p2[1]['tick'] == p[0]['tick'] + 144 and p2[1]['form'] == 'sky_toll'
steps.msg: it rings again 2.4 s after the first
now the Duskmoth is struck too, its 9 grown by the 80% air bonus

steps.assert: scene.creep(c[3]).slow_pm == 500 and scene.creep(c[3]).slow_until == p2[1]['tick'] + 120 and scene.creep(c[3]).stun_until == 0
steps.msg: the flier is slowed 50% for 2 s, not stunned
the ground creeps are stunned again
and the far Gourdling is still out of reach
